description: Automerges every npm update once all of its checks pass; other updates (GitHub Actions, the Node.js version) wait for review. Branch protection on main requires the lint-and-build and integration checks on a branch that is up to date with main, so every merge, which deploys to production, is a tested commit. Security fixes from vulnerability alerts skip the schedule and the 3-day release age, as Renovate does by default.

packageRules.description: Review GitHub Actions updates. The deploy job and preview.yaml run their actions with the cluster's identity token, and only after merge, so no pull request check exercises an update (a new release, or a tag moved to another commit) where it holds that token.

Non-major and digest updates of actions share one pull request; each major gets its own, so one migration does not hold up another, except that config:recommended keeps upload-artifact and download-artifact together, since they must agree on the artifact format.

Hold eslint on v9: eslint-config-next (vendored Babel parser + eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5) isn't ESLint-10-ready, so `eslint .` crashes. Tracked at https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/91702; create-harper holds its Next.js templates the same way. Drop once eslint-config-next ships past it.
